description: Find the Unified Carrier Registration fee for your fleet-size bracket and registration year. Use this tested BusCalc worksheet when the task matches its inputs and scope. Returns named results, units, formula, assumptions, method version, reference-value notes (official figure or your figure, with source and effective date), a check link and a source-page URL. Official reference values are prefilled when omitted; supply every other figure from the user's records. Percent fields take percent numbers. No figures are looked up; no private projects or purchases are accessed. Put tool fields inside inputs. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.

bracket.description: Fleet-size bracket. Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for fleet-size bracket. Unknown is not the same as zero. Options: b1 = 0 to 2 vehicles (also brokers and leasing companies); b2 = 3 to 5 vehicles; b3 = 6 to 20 vehicles; b4 = 21 to 100 vehicles; b5 = 101 to 1,000 vehicles; b6 = 1,001 vehicles and over; broker = Broker or leasing company (no vehicles).

fee26_b1.description: UCR fee for 2026, 0 to 2 vehicles (also brokers and leasing companies) (US dollars). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for ucr fee for 2026, 0 to 2 vehicles (also brokers and leasing companies). Unknown is not the same as zero. Official reference value 46 USD from FMCSA final rule, 91 FR 56063 (49 CFR 367.40 table as restated), effective 2025-01-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used. Used only when year is 2026 and bracket is b1 or broker; ignored otherwise.
